title: Pizza Sauce
summary: This pizza sauce tastes like you have been slaving away at the stove for hours but takes only minutes to make. Worth the little bit of effort for both taste and control over the ingredient list.
ingredients: 170g (6oz/¾ cup) Tomato Paste (puree in the UK)
1 small handful Fresh Basil Leave, thinly sliced and chopped
steps: Add the olive oil and garlic to a saucepan and cook over medium heat for 1-2 minutes, until the garlic is fragrant.
Add the passata, tomato paste and oregano to the pan and stir to combine.
Allow the sauce to come to a simmer and then reduce the heat to low and simmer for a minimum of 10 mins. (longer if you wish to develop flavour more or thicken).
Add the chopped basil and stir through.
